For a vertical hyperbola, \(a=8\), so the difference of distances from any point on the hyperbola to the two foci is \(2a=16\).

Given \(PF_1=3\). Thus,
\[
|PF_1-PF_2|=16 \implies |3-PF_2|=16 \implies PF_2=19.
\]
The distance between foci is
\[
F_1F_2=2c=2\sqrt{64+36}=20.
\]
Therefore, the perimeter is
\[
3+19+20=42.
\]

\[
\boxed{42}
\]
